title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics workflow enhancements and slo-toolkit integration
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: improve automated diagnostics and runbook linking during on-call incidents by enhancing the incident-bot autodiagnostics workflow and integrating with slo-toolkit utilities. This PR implements a new orchestration layer that sequences diagnostics, enriches context with SLO/alert metadata, surfaces compact runbook cards in the on-call UI, and provides quicklink suggestions based on historical incident resolution patterns. Checklist: - [x] Add orchestration for ordered autodiagnostics (cpu/mem/network/kv cache) - [x] Integrate slo-toolkit runbook mapper to attach SLO context and candidate runbooks - [x] Add compact runbook card UI and quicklinks for common escalations - [x] Telemetry: add tracing spans and metrics for diagnostics duration/failures - [x] Add unit and integration tests for the orchestration layer - [x] Add feature-flag gating for rollout and canary testing Context: recent incidents showed long time-to-diagnosis when multiple noisy symptoms were present. The new workflow adds an explicit step ordering (fast cheap checks first, KV cache/batching checks later) and a confidence score used to rank runbook suggestions. This reduces noisy parallel runs and surfaces the most relevant runbooks to the on-call. Rollout: feature-flag enabled; default off for 24h canary on dedicated oncall team. See linked Linear tickets for acceptance criteria.
